reason: Names the owner's own Google OAuth client file. The release can bundle a WireCat client, but none ships (the owner chose no WireCat Google app), so the owner's file is the way in; drive-cli has the same option in its baseline. Review when the vocabulary names an app-credential file: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424

Names the owner's own Google OAuth client by its ID, the first step of the app order in WC-SECR-25 (cli-base docs/standards/security.md), beside --client-file; no shared flag names an app credential. Review when the vocabulary names one: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/424

Calls one generated Google method by its API name, the same command drive-cli has (in its baseline); no shared verb names a raw API call. Review when the vocabulary names it: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/425

Lists the few profiles on this computer, every one at once by design (WC-ACCT-12); a filter would let a caller narrow it to one and read that as the only profile. Review if a computer commonly holds more profiles than fit one screen.
Keeps the short gcal command beside wcat-gcal, as mail does: dropping it would break every script and agent setup that types gcal. Owner decision of 2026-11-02 (docs/dev/DESIGN.md, Command names).
A link to Google's Calendar API error guide that a refusal shows the reader (src/errors.ts); gcal never sends a request there. hostFetch would refuse one.
Words in Google's own API description, copied into src/generated/definitions.ts by scripts/generate.ts; gcal never sends a request there. hostFetch would refuse one.
